descriptor.retrieval_description: Painted aluminum beverage can with a smooth, dry, nonporous metallic sidewall and continuous cylindrical curvature. The intended contact region has no visible seams or interruptions, though it features printed branding graphics.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral sidewall surfaces located within the centered vertical grasp band of the aluminum can.
descriptor.visible_surface_material: Painted aluminum metal with a glossy finish.
descriptor.local_geometry: Convex cylindrical curvature forming a continuous, smooth surface without prominent ridges or seams in the primary contact band.
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible on the front and sides facing the camera.
descriptor.uncertainty: The rear side of the object is occluded from camera view, but the cylindrical symmetry ensures similar material and geometry.
